signal: Fivetran and dbt Labs completed their merger in June 2026 to build data infrastructure for trusted AI agents.

email.body1:
Will, saw dbt Labs closed its merger with Fivetran this month, with the combined platform now aimed at trusted AI agents.

Mergers usually mean a wider commercial account map than the team can cover before territories settle, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your commercial segment off hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your commercial number
email.body2:
Will, quick follow-up for your dbt Labs commercial team.

Post-merger, the number per rep usually climbs faster than the team can. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings each rep needs to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your commercial segment needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Will, last bit of proof for your dbt Labs team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer data-tooling teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Will, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling commercial pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority while the merger settles, no problem at all. Integration quarters are their own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your commercial motion? I'll tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
